entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker, captain of the Belligerent, who races to Orazca with Jace and secretly comes to trust and like him.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker without his memories whose illusions and telepathy help the crew; his memories begin to return at Orazca.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A winged crew member of the Belligerent who scouts ahead and waits for Jace's illusory beacon.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin crew member of the Belligerent who taught Jace a rude song.

entities.name: Amelia
entities.description: A pirate helmsmage of the Belligerent's crew who ensnares Huatli with canvas.

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: An elder River Herald and protector of Orazca who rides an elemental, takes the compass and abandons Huatli to stop Kumena.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A Sun Empire dinosaur rider and planeswalker who retrieves the compass from a vampire and is then robbed by the pirates and betrayed by Tishana.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A huge horned planeswalker draped in red-hot chains who proposes an alliance with Huatli to escape Ixalan.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: A River Herald whom Tishana is racing to stop.

entities.name: Lord Nicolas
entities.description: A man whom Jace and Vraska joke may be a rock collector, in connection with the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon parun of the Izzet who appears in Jace's returning memory of becoming Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The Golden City, which rises from the jungle like a flower and is believed to hold the Immortal Sun and the barrier keeping planeswalkers on Ixalan.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: A relic in Orazca whose purpose is unknown; rumored to give eternal life or power, or to be the key to leaving the plane.

entities.name: Thaumatic Compass
entities.description: The compass that points toward Orazca; stolen by a vampire, taken by Huatli and Tishana, then retaken by Vraska.

entities.name: The Belligerent
entities.description: Vraska's pirate ship, whose crew follows her through the jungle.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: The pirate alliance to which Vraska's crew belongs.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: The merfolk of Ixalan, to which Tishana and Kumena belong.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The dinosaur-riding empire of Ixalan; its greatest warriors never kill.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire conquistadors, one of whom steals the compass.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose song Vraska sings.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of Niv-Mizzet seen in Jace's memory.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane on which the race for Orazca takes place.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The home plane of Jace and Vraska, glimpsed in Jace's returning memories.

entities.name: Forum of Azor
entities.description: The Ravnican site where Jace became the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Living Guildpact
entities.description: The title Jace received on Ravnica.

entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: The outpost where a merfolk overheard Vraska and Jace's conversation.

entities.name: Planeswalking
entities.description: The ability to travel between planes, blocked on Ixalan by whatever is locked in Orazca.

events.summary: Vraska steers the boat toward the bank as the river narrows, and the two planeswalkers camp in the boat for the night.
events.quote: We'll sleep in the boat,

events.summary: Jace conjures a glowing illusory draft horse as a beacon for Malcolm and the crew.
events.quote: A large draft horse materialized above them, glowing a delicate blue against the night sky, and ran upward into the canopy.

events.summary: Vraska sings a Golgari song and talks with Jace before he falls asleep.
events.quote: The Golgari have little to be cheery about.

events.summary: Vraska decides she can trust Jace, possibly wants more than friendship, and resolves to petrify whoever stole his memories.
events.quote: Vraska knew in that moment that, memory or no, this was a man she could trust

events.summary: Vraska resolves to petrify whoever stole Jace's memories.
events.quote: Vraska couldn't wait to petrify whoever had stolen his memories.

events.summary: They abandon the boat and hack through the jungle, finding a dinosaur-made path.
events.quote: Vraska and Jace abandoned their boat the next morning.

events.summary: A vampire conquistador ambushes them under a cloud of dark smoke.
events.quote: A thick cloud of dark smoke suddenly flooded the grove around them.

events.summary: Jace dispels the darkness spell and Vraska fights the exposed vampire while Jace conjures an illusory storm.
events.quote: The dark smoke dissipated, leaving a conquistador standing exposed.

events.summary: The vampire knocks Jace down and steals the thaumatic compass, fleeing into the jungle.
events.quote: snagging the thaumatic compass from the ground at Jace's feet

events.summary: Jace goes to track the vampire but hears the minds of Tishana and Huatli pursuing it.
events.quote: What he heard instead was a pair of furious internal monologues.

events.summary: Tishana's illusory flying snake crashes into Jace's psychic defense.
events.quote: An immense, illusory, flying snake crashed into his arms and split on either side of Jace's psychic defense.

events.summary: Tishana snares Jace with vines, breaking his illusion.
events.quote: vines whipped up from the forest floor to wrap themselves around Jace's legs.

events.summary: Tishana and Huatli introduce themselves and Tishana demands the compass or their deaths.
events.quote: Hand over the compass or die where you stand.

events.summary: Jace tells them the vampire took the compass, and Tishana and Huatli leave to hunt it.
events.quote: The vampire took the compass from us.

events.summary: Huatli and her dinosaur hunt the vampire for nine hours.
events.quote: It took nine hours.

events.summary: Huatli's dinosaur seizes and shakes the vampire until the compass falls out, then Huatli lets it go and leaves the vampire to a raptor.
events.quote: An odd-looking compass flung out of her pocket and hit the ground.

events.summary: Tishana examines the compass, which lights and shows Orazca is half a day away.
events.quote: The end of our peregrination is near.

events.summary: Tishana betrays Huatli as the Belligerent crew ambushes them and Amelia binds Huatli in canvas.
events.quote: the slap of a large flap of canvas covering her face and knocking her off her mount

events.summary: Vraska petrifies Huatli's clawfoot and retakes the compass.
events.quote: Her clawfoot was in front of her, crouching for an attack, jaws wide open . . . and entirely encased in stone.

events.summary: Vraska explains how the crew caught up, using Malcolm in the sky and Jace's telepathy.
events.quote: It's much easier to find shortcuts with an eye in the sky and a telepath on the ground.

events.summary: Huatli summons clawfoots that scatter the pirates, and Tishana conjures a flood against the fleeing crew.
events.quote: she summoned a flood to careen through the jungle

events.summary: Tishana abandons Huatli to stop Kumena alone, breaking their bond.
events.quote: I must stop Kumena on my own.

events.summary: Angrath appears and chases Huatli, entangling her with a chain.
events.quote: a chain whacked and wrapped around her ankle, yanking Huatli to the forest floor.

events.summary: Angrath says he will not harm Huatli, and proposes they escape together by finding the city.
events.quote: Whatever prevents us from leaving this plane is locked in that city.

events.summary: Angrath adds that they must kill everyone who tries to steal Orazca.
events.quote: And all we have to do is kill everyone who tries to steal Orazca from our grasp.

events.summary: The compass vibrates and Malcolm sees the city ahead as the crew runs through the fog and mountains.
events.quote: It's on the hills ahead!

events.summary: The crew sees the spires of Orazca.
events.quote: Shining as golden beacons above the green, the spires of Orazca pierced the sky.

events.summary: Vraska and Jace discuss what the Immortal Sun might do, joking about Lord Nicolas.
events.quote: Maybe Lord Nicolas is a rock collector?

events.summary: An earthquake shakes the clearing and Orazca begins rising from the jungle.
events.quote: The city itself was emerging from the jungle with every jostle of the earthquake.

events.summary: Malcolm says someone must have arrived at the city first, and a great beast bellows.
events.quote: Someone must have arrived at the city first.

events.summary: The city opens like a flower in gold, turquoise, amber and jade.
events.quote: The city itself had opened like the petals of a flower.

events.summary: Jace loses his grip on a boulder and tumbles down the waterfall as Vraska reaches for him.
events.quote: the ground jerked sideways once more, and Jace lost his grip.

events.summary: Vraska falls after Jace and is swallowed up by the pool at the bottom.
events.quote: Vraska was swallowed up by the pool at the bottom.

events.summary: Vraska is struck by a vision of Ravnica from Jace's mind while swimming.
events.quote: Vraska was still in Ixalan, but the image in her mind was of Ravnica.

events.summary: Vraska sees Jace's memory of becoming the Living Guildpact at the Forum of Azor.
events.quote: It was the day Jace became the Living Guildpact.

events.summary: Vraska realizes Jace is regaining all his memories and fears their friendship will dissolve.
events.quote: He would remember he was the Guildpact and she was an assassin and their friendship would certainly dissolve.

relations.note: Vraska trusts Jace and values their friendship.
relations.quote: Vraska knew in that moment that, memory or no, this was a man she could trust

relations.note: Vraska leads the crew running behind her.
relations.quote: Her heart leapt as she ran, Jace at her side and her crew at her back.

relations.note: She is an elder of the River Heralds.
relations.quote: My name is Tishana, an elder of the River Heralds and protector of Orazca.

relations.note: A warrior poet of the Sun Empire.
relations.quote: I am Huatli of the Sun Empire, Warrior Poet and vanquisher of interlopers.

relations.note: She sets out to stop Kumena.
relations.quote: I must stop Kumena on my own.

relations.note: Huatli regards Tishana as a traitor after being abandoned.
relations.quote: Damn merfolk! Where did that traitor go?!

relations.note: Angrath proposes that the two planeswalkers help each other escape.
relations.quote: We can help each other escape to different worlds if we find it.

relations.note: Amelia obeys Vraska's order to release Huatli.
